backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining a Lead type and Map-based storage with functions to create leads (with duplicate email check), get a single lead by email, get all leads, and get leads count.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the implementation of a leads display page/section showing all records from the Leads collection in table format with relevant fields.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files including components, pages, hooks, and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind directives and CSS custom properties defining OKLCH color system variables for light and dark themes, plus base styles for body and border.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with viewport meta tag, title "NextHire AI", root div, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component using TanStack Router to define routes (/, /admin, /debug-leads, /leads) with root layout including Header and Footer components.
Section component displaying four student-focused benefits (save time, increase interviews, apply globally, perfect for internships) in a grid with icons.
Form component for early access signup collecting full name, email, country, and target job role with validation, duplicate email detection, success/error states, and backend integration via useCreateLead mutation.
frontend/src/components/FAQSection.tsx: Accordion-style FAQ section with six questions/answers about the AI resume builder, ATS optimization, pricing, security, export formats, and differentiation.
Section displaying three main features (AI Resume Builder, ATS Checker, Job Tracker) in a grid with icons, titles, and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying NextHire AI branding, navigation links (About, Legal, Contact), copyright notice, and a powered-by caffeine.ai attribution with dynamic UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed header navigation component with logo, desktop/mobile menus, smooth scrolling to page sections, and navigation to home and leads pages using TanStack Router.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero section with headline, subheadline, CTA buttons for early access signup and how-it-works, plus a laptop mockup image showcasing the resume builder.
frontend/src/components/HowItWorksSectio: Three-step process section explaining how to use the resume builder: enter info, AI optimizes, download resume, with numbered icons and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/PricingSection.t: Pricing section displaying Free and Pro plans with features, pricing, and CTA buttons that scroll to the signup section.
frontend/src/components/ProblemSection.t: Section highlighting four common resume problems students face (ATS failures, poor formatting, generic content, lack of achievements) with icons.
Section showcasing NextHire AI's four key solutions (ATS optimization, keyword matching, achievement rewriting, clean templates) with icons and hover effects.
frontend/src/components/TestimonialsSect: Testimonials section displaying three student reviews with 5-star ratings, profile images, names, roles, and quotes from users in India, UK, and USA.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook managing backend actor creation with Internet Identity authentication, using TanStack Query for caching and automatic query invalidation on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, providing login/logout functionality, identity management, and authentication status tracking with support for delegation identity validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for backend operations, including fetching all leads and creating new leads with automatic cache invalidation on successful mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a blue and white color theme for both light and dark modes, including primary, secondary, accent, and chart colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page displaying all lead submissions in a table format with loading states, error handling, and formatted timestamps.
frontend/src/pages/DebugLeadsPage.tsx: Debug page for testing that displays all leads from the collection in a simple HTML table with basic styling and timestamp formatting.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Main landing page component that composes multiple sections including hero, early access form, problem, solution, how it works, benefits, testimonials, and pricing.
frontend/src/pages/LeadsPage.tsx: Public-facing leads page that displays all lead records in a styled table with loading states, error handling, and formatted timestamps.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, container settings, custom animations, and typography/container-queries/animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state file for 'NextHire AI' tracking one existing feature for displaying Leads collection records in a table format. Uses schema version 1.0.0 with instant clarification mode and no pending feature requests.
